title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
description: Tanjiro Kamado sets out to avenge his slaughtered family and cure his demon-turned sister Nezuko through breathing techniques and master swordsmanship.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
description: High schooler Yuji Itadori swallows the finger of the King of Curses Sukuna, plunging into Tokyo Jujutsu High under mentor Satoru Gojo.

title: Attack on Titan (Shingeki no Kyojin)
description: Humanity's last remnants behind three concentric stone walls struggle against man-eating giants before discovering a geopolitical conspiracy across the sea.

title: Chainsaw Man
description: Denji merges with his canine chainsaw devil Pochita, joining Public Safety Devil Hunter division under the enigmatic Makima.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
description: Brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric search for the Philosopher's Stone to restore their bodies following a catastrophic human transmutation ritual.

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
description: Studio Trigger and CDPR tell the tragic story of street kid David Martinez and netrunner Lucy navigating the neon meatgrinder of Night City.

title: Solo Leveling
description: The weakest E-Rank hunter Sung Jinwoo reawakens inside a double dungeon with a mysterious quest interface that allows him alone to level up infinitely.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
description: An immortal elven mage retraces the steps of her hero party decades after vanquishing the Demon King, learning to understand the fragility of human lifespans.

title: Cowboy Bebop
description: Bounty hunter Spike Spiegel and his misfit crew aboard the spaceship Bebop cruise the solar system while running from their pasts to Yoko Kanno's jazz soundtrack.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion
description: Fourteen-year-old Shinji Ikari is summoned by his estranged father to pilot a biomechanical Eva unit against apocalyptic extraterrestrial Angels attacking Tokyo-3.

title: Vinland Saga Season 1 & 2
description: Thorfinn seeks vengeance for his father's duel against Viking commander Askeladd, before embarking on a transformative path toward peace.

title: Spirited Away (Sen to Chihiro no Kamikakushi)
description: Ten-year-old Chihiro is trapped inside a supernatural spirit bathhouse ruled by the witch Yubaba, striving to save her parents and remember her real name.

title: Princess Mononoke
description: Prince Ashitaka seeks a cure for a demon boar curse, finding himself caught in an uncompromising war between industrial Iron Town and wolf-raised San.

title: Your Name. (Kimi no Na wa.)
description: High schoolers Taki in Tokyo and Mitsuha in rural Itomori mysteriously swap bodies across time as the Tiamat comet approaches Earth.

title: Akira
description: Katsuhiro Otomo's hand-drawn cyberpunk landmark set in post-World War III Neo-Tokyo, where biker Kaneda tries to stop his telekinetically unstable friend Tetsuo.

title: Ghost in the Shell (1995)
description: Mamoru Oshii's cybernetic masterwork following Major Motoko Kusanagi as she pursues the elusive cyber-hacker known as the Puppet Master.
